title: Conditional 1 Writing-Satzbausteine U3/U4
designGoal: 100 korrekt kodierte Conditional-1-Satzbausteine, die direkt auf Klausur-Writing-Aufgaben vorbereiten: Travel Blog, Review, Internship Report, California Opinion/Argument, Advice Email, Report/Comment/Reflection.
grammarRule: Conditional 1: if-clause in simple present; main clause with will/can/should/may/must + infinitive. No future tense in the if-clause.
writingScaffoldRule: Every sentence is reusable as a sentence starter or support sentence in a later writing task. Use it with opinion, reason, example, result, contrast, or conclusion.

sourceMaterials.use: real exam writing task: Desert Southwest travel blog
review writing: attitude and behavior on Antelope Canyon tour
career tips, dream internship, internship report patterns
California reflection, opinion paragraph, argument writing, useful phrases
advice email about summer camp, parents and communication
post, comment, report, debate and reflection writing

vocabularySources: existing Unit 3/Unit 4 exam, writing, grammar and support transcripts listed in sourceMaterials
